newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakura leads Japan banks lower in morning.
newsitem.headline: Sakura leads Japan banks lower in morning.

text.p: Japan's bank sector shares, led by Sakura Bank Ltd, fell in Friday morning trade, battered by dissolving of cross-share holdings and spooked by growing concerns over the financial health of the sector, brokers said.

As of 0125 GMT, Sakura Bank, which fell to a limit low on Thursday, was down 72 yen at 627 yen, the largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo bourse. It was also the most heavily traded issue in a trade of 7.521 million shares.

Sumitomo Bank Ltd, the second most heavily traded issue, was down 100 yen at 1,360 yen, with 4.875 million shares traded. Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd lost 140 yen to 1,890 yen, ranking seventh with 3.495 million shares traded.
